title: Zesty Charred Venezuelan Cheese Quesadilla
description: A charred, creamy, quick-fix Venezuelan dish featuring tabasco sauce, perfect for a lacto-vegetarian friendly meal, this zesty cheese quesadilla is a delicious twist on traditional Venezuelan cuisine.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Butter one side of each tortilla.
Place one tortilla, buttered side down, in the skillet.
Sprinkle shredded Queso Blanco on half of the tortilla.
Drizzle Tabasco Sauce over the cheese.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the cheese.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is charred and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also charred.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
